cards.back: A branch of mathematics that uses letters and symbols to represent numbers and quantities
A letter or symbol that represents an unknown value
A number that does not change
A mathematical phrase that can contain variables, constants, and operations
A mathematical statement that shows two expressions are equal
An equation where the highest power of the variable is 1
An equation where the highest power of the variable is 2
Breaking down an expression into simpler factors
a(b + c) = ab + ac
a + b = b + a and ab = ba
(a + b) + c = a + (b + c) and (ab)c = a(bc)
a + 0 = a and a × 1 = a
A relation where each input has exactly one output
The set of all possible input values for a function
The set of all possible output values for a function
The measure of steepness of a line
y = mx + b, where m is slope and b is y-intercept
y - y₁ = m(x - x₁)

cards.front: What is a system of equations?
cards.back: A set of two or more equations with the same variables
